creative_brief_summary.prompt_excerpt:
FINISHED PROFESSIONAL INSTAGRAM AD — Instagram 4:5 — LANGUAGE: tr.
Deliver a publishable, flattened social advertisement — typography, price hierarchy, CTA, and brand lockups integrated in the composition (not a blank background for later overlay).

LANGUAGE LOCK:
- Campaign language is tr. All user-visible slogans, headlines, CTAs, and supporting lines MUST be tr.
- Do not invent or render English slogans/headlines/CTAs when language is tr.

CAMPAIGN INTENT:
- location
- Primary focus: Adams Morgan'ın canlı atmosferi ve The Temple logosu
- Emotional angle: Canlı ve merkezi bir yaşam tarzı

CREATIVE DIRECTOR PRODUCTION BRIEF:
- Objective: The Temple projesinin lokasyon avantajlarını vurgulamak.
- Big Idea: Adams Morgan'da Yaşamın Kalbi
- Hero: Adams Morgan'ın Kalbinde Yaşa
- Sales Hook: Adams Morgan'ın kalbinde premium yaşam
- Offer: 
- Supporting (max 2): Kültürel çeşitlilik ve zengin sosyal yaşam. · Merkezi konum, her yere kolay erişim.
- CTA: Detayları Keşfet

DESIGN DIRECTION (creative freedom — no fixed panels):
- Visual mood: Adams Morgan'ın canlı atmosferini yansıtan bir dış mekan görüntüsü.
- Hierarchy: Location name / advantage leads; supporting place cues secondary; CTA clear.
- Typography character: Modern ve şık yazı tipleri, dikkat çekici başlıklar.
- Composition: Görselde The Temple'ın merkezi konumunu ve çevresini vurgulayan bir açı.
- Image treatment: Preserve real project architecture/photography — enhance atmosphere, do not redesign. Subtle grade toward premium RE editorial.
- Contrast: High readability for primary message and CTA against the locked photograph
- Brand presence: One verified project logo lockup — never invent or duplicate
- CTA importance: Single clear CTA; visible and actionable, not tiny footer text
- Information density: sparse
- Premium level: elevated
- Freedom: Language=tr. Full creative freedom for placement — no forced left panel, bottom band, badge grid, icon row, or card stack. Vary composition by campaign.

golden_principles.composition: Photograph-led full-bleed with intentional negative space; text rides dark/light contrast zones — never a flat top-stack of logo→headline→CTA.
golden_principles.hierarchy: ONE primary message; headline or price leads by intent; support quieter; single CTA.
golden_principles.typography: Display/serif for hero line; restrained sans for support/price/CTA; deliberate size jumps.
golden_principles.image_treatment: Preserve master asset quality; add editable gradient/overlay contrast — do not AI-regrade.
golden_principles.negative_space: Let the photograph breathe; premium ≠ more elements.
golden_principles.overlays: Localized dark or light gradients for text-safe zones as editable layers.
golden_principles.logo: One real project logo; top-left or top-center by intent; never invent.
golden_principles.cta: Single clear actionable CTA; proportionate pill/button — not tiny footer text.
golden_principles.spacing: Safe margins ~6–8% width; consistent rhythm between eyebrow→headline→support→CTA.
golden_principles.density: Sparse for lifestyle/location; medium only when price/offer requires it.
golden_principles.alignment: Intent-specific: left price stack, center brand/lifestyle, split location.
golden_principles.focal_point: Image focal zone reserved; type sits in planned text-safe areas.
